```{r}

############################################################
# 0. Environment
############################################################

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(nlmixr2)
library(rxode2)
library(here)

here::dr_here()

data_file <- here(
  "Data",
  "warfarin_full_dataset_ID9_cleaned_for_popPKPD.csv"
)

output_dir <- here(
  "Warfarin_popPK_modeling",
  "M2_Random_Effects_Comparison"
)

dir.create(
  output_dir,
  recursive = TRUE,
  showWarnings = FALSE
)

stopifnot(file.exists(data_file))

cat("Input data file:", data_file, "\n")
cat("Output directory:", output_dir, "\n")


try(rxode2::rxClean(), silent = TRUE)
try(rxode2::rxForget(), silent = TRUE)

gc()

rxode2::setRxThreads(1)

cat("rxode2 threads:", rxode2::getRxThreads(), "\n")

############################################################
# Common PopPK fitting control
# Selected from M0 estimation-setting QC
############################################################

popPK_control <- nlmixr2est::foceiControl(
  outerOpt = "bobyqa",
  optExpression = FALSE
)
```

```{r}

############################################################
# 1. Read and prepare PopPK data
############################################################

dat_raw <- read_csv(
  here("Data", "warfarin_full_dataset_ID9_cleaned_for_popPKPD.csv"),
  show_col_types = FALSE
)


pk_data <- dat_raw %>%
  filter(evid == 1 | (evid == 0 & dvid == "cp")) %>%
  mutate(
    ID   = as.integer(id),
    TIME = as.numeric(time),
    DV   = ifelse(evid == 1, NA_real_, as.numeric(dv)),
    AMT  = ifelse(evid == 1, as.numeric(amt), 0),
    EVID = as.integer(evid),
    CMT  = ifelse(EVID == 1, "depot", "central"),

    WT   = as.numeric(wt),
    AGE  = as.numeric(age),
    SEX  = tolower(trimws(as.character(sex)))
  ) %>%
  select(
    ID, TIME, DV, AMT, EVID, CMT,
    WT, AGE, SEX
  ) %>%
  arrange(ID, TIME, desc(EVID))


names(pk_data)
table(pk_data$EVID, pk_data$CMT)
print(pk_data, n=279)

```

```{r}

############################################################
# 2. Model 1: full IIV model
############################################################

M2_full_IIV <- function() {
  ini({
    tka <- log(1)
    tcl <- log(0.145)
    tv  <- log(8.882)

    eta.ka ~ 0.1
    eta.cl ~ 0.1
    eta.v  ~ 0.1

    add.err  <- 0.3
    prop.err <- 0.2
  })

  model({
    ka <- exp(tka + eta.ka)
    cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl)
    v  <- exp(tv  + eta.v)

    d/dt(depot)   = -ka * depot
    d/dt(central) =  ka * depot - cl / v * central

    cp = central / v

    cp ~ add(add.err) + prop(prop.err)
  })
}

```

```{r}

############################################################
# 3. Model 2: no eta.ka model
############################################################

M2_no_eta_ka <- function() {
  ini({
    tka <- log(1)
    tcl <- log(0.145)
    tv  <- log(8.882)

    eta.cl ~ 0.1
    eta.v  ~ 0.1

    add.err  <- 0.3
    prop.err <- 0.2
  })

  model({
    ka <- exp(tka)
    cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl)
    v  <- exp(tv  + eta.v)

    d/dt(depot)   = -ka * depot
    d/dt(central) =  ka * depot - cl / v * central

    cp = central / v

    cp ~ add(add.err) + prop(prop.err)
  })
}

```

```{r}

############################################################
# 4. Model 3: CL-only IIV model
############################################################

M2_CL_only <- function() {
  ini({
    tka <- log(1)
    tcl <- log(0.145)
    tv  <- log(8.882)

    eta.cl ~ 0.1

    add.err  <- 0.3
    prop.err <- 0.2
  })

  model({
    ka <- exp(tka)
    cl <- exp(tcl + eta.cl)
    v  <- exp(tv)

    d/dt(depot)   = -ka * depot
    d/dt(central) =  ka * depot - cl / v * central

    cp = central / v

    cp ~ add(add.err) + prop(prop.err)
  })
}

```

```{r}

############################################################
# 5. Fit random effects models
############################################################

fit_M2_full_IIV <- nlmixr2(
  M2_full_IIV,
  data = pk_data,
  est = "focei",
  control = popPK_control
)

fit_M2_no_eta_ka <- nlmixr2(
  M2_no_eta_ka,
  data = pk_data,
  est = "focei",
  control = popPK_control
)

fit_M2_CL_only <- nlmixr2(
  M2_CL_only,
  data = pk_data,
  est = "focei",
  control = popPK_control
)

```

```{r}
############################################################
# 6. M2 parameter estimation tables using nlmixr2rpt
############################################################

library(nlmixr2rpt)
library(onbrand)
library(flextable)

obnd <- onbrand::read_template(
  template = system.file(
    package = "nlmixr2rpt",
    "templates",
    "nlmixr_obnd_template.docx"
  ),
  mapping = system.file(
    package = "nlmixr2rpt",
    "templates",
    "nlmixr_obnd_template.yaml"
  )
)

rpt_yaml <- system.file(
  package = "nlmixr2rpt",
  "templates",
  "report_fit.yaml"
)

get_rpt_table <- function(fit, caption) {

  rptdetails <- nlmixr2rpt::yaml_read_fit(
    obnd    = obnd,
    rptyaml = rpt_yaml,
    fit     = fit
  )$rptdetails

  result <- nlmixr2rpt::gen_pest_table(
    obnd       = obnd,
    fit        = fit,
    rptdetails = rptdetails,
    verbose    = FALSE
  )

  flextable::set_caption(
    result$ft[[1]],
    caption = caption
  )
}

M2_full_table <- get_rpt_table(
  fit_M2_full_IIV,
  "M2 full-IIV model: Parameter estimates"
)

M2_no_eta_ka_table <- get_rpt_table(
  fit_M2_no_eta_ka,
  "M2 model without IIV on Ka: Parameter estimates"
)

M2_CL_only_table <- get_rpt_table(
  fit_M2_CL_only,
  "M2 CL-only IIV model: Parameter estimates"
)

M2_full_table
M2_no_eta_ka_table
M2_CL_only_table


```

```{r}

############################################################
# 7. Random effects structure comparison table
############################################################

M2_compare <- tibble(
  model_code = c(
    "M2_full_IIV",
    "M2_no_eta_ka",
    "M2_CL_only"
  ),
  random_effects = c(
    "eta.ka + eta.cl + eta.v",
    "eta.cl + eta.v",
    "eta.cl only"
  ),
  message = c(
    paste(fit_M2_full_IIV$message, collapse = "; "),
    paste(fit_M2_no_eta_ka$message, collapse = "; "),
    paste(fit_M2_CL_only$message, collapse = "; ")
  ),
  OBJF = c(
    fit_M2_full_IIV$objf,
    fit_M2_no_eta_ka$objf,
    fit_M2_CL_only$objf
  ),
  AIC = c(
    AIC(fit_M2_full_IIV),
    AIC(fit_M2_no_eta_ka),
    AIC(fit_M2_CL_only)
  ),
  BIC = c(
    BIC(fit_M2_full_IIV),
    BIC(fit_M2_no_eta_ka),
    BIC(fit_M2_CL_only)
  ),
  role = c(
    "Reference model from M1",
    "Reduced model without IIV on ka",
    "Further reduced model retaining only IIV on CL/F"
  )
) %>%
  mutate(
    delta_OBJF_vs_full = OBJF - OBJF[model_code == "M2_full_IIV"],
    delta_AIC_vs_full  = AIC  - AIC[model_code == "M2_full_IIV"],
    delta_BIC_vs_full  = BIC  - BIC[model_code == "M2_full_IIV"]
  )

print(M2_compare, n = Inf, width = Inf)

csv_output_file <- file.path(
  output_dir,
  "M2_random_effects_comparison_results.csv"
)

write_csv(
  M2_compare,
  csv_output_file
)

cat("CSV saved to:", csv_output_file, "\n")
cat("CSV exists:", file.exists(csv_output_file), "\n")

```
